items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I played with Jimmy Rushing's band for a while. He had a good band, yes. He had myself, Emmett Berry, Dickie Wells, Buddy Tate.

ctx.x: Yes, well he was a, I mean, it seems as though Benny Moten's band from Kansas City was very successful even before it got to be very good.
I mean, when it wasn't really as far as you can guage from records, it's not until they get Basie ...........
